betaReleaseNotes: Star-AI 4.0 has been temporarily locked due to a bug.
releaseNotes: 🌐 English is now the default language for new accounts.
👤 Language preferences are saved separately for each account.
💾 Your selected language is preserved across future logins.
🪟 Improved Blur and Liquid Glass settings.
🎬 Smoother animations for the Settings menu.
💎 Improved button transparency and matte appearance.
🎨 Fixed dark and unreadable text issues.
🔧 Fixed text color issues when Liquid Glass is disabled.
